_default.notes: Example brand kit (generic — no real user data lives in the repo). The kit carries brand IDENTITY: voice, visual system, a FEW stable niche/identity hashtags, and policy. It is NOT a content library: per-post hashtags and CTAs are generated on the fly to match each post's content, not pasted from stored lists. Keep `hashtags.default` to a couple of niche anchors; leave `cta` empty unless you have a fixed legal/brand line every post must carry. Real kits live in the server data dir (~/.honk/brand.json), never here.
